notes: Characters can now read back through everything you have ever said to them. Until now the memory pass only ever looked forward, at messages sent since the last time it ran — so everything from before it existed, and everything lost to the faults fixed a couple of builds ago, was sitting in the history unread. Read back through your chats, on a character's memories screen, walks every conversation they were part of, private and group alike, forty messages at a time, and writes down what is worth keeping. It tells you first how many requests it will make and that they are billed to your key, so a long history is never an unexpected bill, and if the history is longer than one pass can cover it says how much is being skipped and invites you to run it again. It only ever adds — nothing already saved is changed or removed, each chunk is told what is already on the list so it does not repeat itself, and a second run over the same conversations adds nothing. A progress bar shows how far through it is and Stop ends it wherever it has got to, keeping what it found. A chunk that fails is noted in the log and the rest carry on. Everything it writes carries a record of which part of which conversation it came from, so it works with the forget feature the same as anything learned live.
